heading: ABOUT
manifesto: Based in Cebu, Philippines, I bridge the gap between complex code and compelling narratives. As a Graphics and Design student, I approach web development with a filmmaker's lens — treating every interface as a storyboard and every user journey as a cinematic experience.

My background in directing and scriptwriting allows me to bring a unique sense of pacing and visual flow to responsive web projects. Whether I'm coding with Three.js or designing for sustainable, indigenous-inspired brands, my goal is to create digital spaces that are as functional as they are resonant.
note: BS Graphics and Design — CTU Main Campus
